answer.original_source: NN, Inc. (company announcement, late June 2026; relayed by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01)
answer.new_information: NN, Inc. says it is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling of NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and targets US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. These are company statements with no capex figure, no shipment or customer confirmation, and no NVIDIA confirmation. The 2026 target is forward guidance, not a result. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal is a fact reported by Yahoo, not from NN. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a Simply Wall St style narrative projection and an unnamed analyst rumour, and they are not NVIDIA data. The record concerns NN, Inc., a supplier, not NVDA, the covered name; no NVDA period or definition is mapped.
